home.footer: Kua whakamaoritia te paetukutuku me te waatea i roto i te 100+ reo!
home.descriptionA: Ko te miihini-a-tinana matua me te 6+ tau o te wheako ki te tango hua mai i nga whakaritenga rangirua ki nga punaha whakangao pono. Ka hoahoa ahau i te hoahoanga kei muri i nga tono React, Angular, .NET, Node.js, Java, C#, Go, me SQL: nga rohe ratonga marama, tauira raraunga roa, tauira uru haumaru, me Ka taea e nga roopu ara tuku te mahi ma te maia.

Mai i te SaaS hanga-hanga e huri ana i nga raraunga ripanga ki nga tono kua rite ki nga kaihoko ki nga papaaho tukutuku whakaputa moni, ka hangaia e ahau he rorohiko huri noa i te rerenga mahi, te tupono, me te uara ine e whai take ana ki nga tangata e whakamahi ana.

takeoff_engine.summary: Ngā ripanga kāore e rite ana e uru mai ana. Ngā whakatau hanga me ngā tono reri mō te kaihoko e puta ana. He hua SaaS i hangaia huri noa i te rerenga mahi tūturu a te kaikirimana.
takeoff_engine.lens: Ko ngā kawemai ngāwari me whai tauira ōkawa o roto: ko te whakaae ki ngā hōputu maha atu kāore e tika kia whakangāwari i ngā ture tātai e whakawhirinaki ana te tono.

inventory_register.summary: He rerenga mahi wāhi hoko me Angular me Node.js e hono ana i ngā kaiwhakamahi kua whakamana, te tika o te rārangi, me te rerenga utu whakatairite.
inventory_register.lens: He nui ake te rehita moni i te mata utu. Me whai rohe mārama ngā tūnga, ngā huringa taonga, me ngā āhua utu kia noho haepapa ai te rerenga mahi.

grocery_app.summary: He taupānga .NET 9 Blazor me ngā rohe kaiwhakahaere, ratonga, me te putunga, te manawarohanga Entity Framework Core, me te huinga whakamātautau whānui.
grocery_app.lens: Ka whiwhi wāhi te wehenga ina taea ngā ture pakihi te whakamātautau motuhake i te atanga me te paparanga manawaroa.

payrollobol.summary: Ko te tukatuka utu GnuCOBOL ka tūtaki ki te pukapuka nui SQLite me te papamahi whakahaere Svelte.
payrollobol.lens: Ka tīmata te tika pūtea i te whakaaturanga: ko te tatauranga pene whētuituhi me ngā whakaurunga whakataurite e mārama ai te neke moni.

interop.summary: He tohutoro reo-katoa e pa ana ki {languages} reo whakahaere me {patterns} tauira whakahaere, e titiro ana ki nga mea e puta ana ki nga roheni o te runtime.
interop.lens: Ko te wāhanga uaua ko te kirimana i waenga i ngā wā whakahaere: ko te whakawhiti raraunga, te whanonga tukanga, me te whakahaerenga tārua ka nui ake te hira o te wetereo.

formatter.summary: He linter me whakahua tuhinga WebAssembly i tuhihia ki a Zig ma JSON, YAML, XML, HTML, TOML, CSV me TSV. Ka whakapumau me whakahua ka haere ki roto i te kauru.
formatter.lens: Ko te whakahua he take pono: whakapapa ki te wetereo pono, tiaki i te tuhinga a te kaituhi, me tiaki i te raraunga ki te kiritaki.

portfolio_website.summary: Te pae kei roto koe: he pōro pūtea React me ngā reo 100+, ngā whakawhitiwhiti āheitanga, me ngā taputapu WebAssembly e mahi ana.
portfolio_website.lens: Kāore e tika kia pērā te whakaturanga pūmau he wheako pūmau. Ka taea e ngā whakawhitiwhiti whai rawa te noho ki te kaihoko me te kore tūmau taupānga.

biblioteca.summary: He ara whakawhenua Python e huri ana i tētahi puna ihirangi hanganga ki te pōro pūtea e wātea ana i ngā reo 100+.
biblioteca.lens: He raru tiaki raraunga te āheitanga ā-ao, pērā anō he raru whakamāori. Ko tētahi puna pono e whakahaere ana i ngā huringa ihirangi.

personal_summary.title: Whakarāpopototanga Whaiaro
personal_summary.text: Ko ahau he kaipūkaha tino-whakapapa katoa e noho ana i Orlando, FL nona te huarahi mai i te raru hua ki te putanga whakaputa. Ka whiriwhiria e au nga hangarau hei mahi i te punaha: .NET me te Anga Hinonga Matua inaa he rohe kaha te hanganga me te tohe tonu e taea te whakamatautau; Angular or React when complex Ko nga rerengamahi me whai atanga ka taea te pupuri; Node.js, Haere ranei ina hiahia te API, te whakauru, te taputapu mahi nui ranei ki te wa whakahaere. Puta noa i nga hua SaaS, nga rerenga mahi o roto, me nga papaa e anga ana ki nga kaihoko, ka arahi ahau me nga tauhokohoko maamaa, te hoahoa haumaru me te kaha, te whakamatautau aunoa, me nga mahi tuku ka awhina i nga roopu ki te kawe i nga punaha utu nui me te kore e waiho he nama whakahaere.

entries.title: Hangarau Tāpae Katoa
entries.text: Ka arahi ahau i te tuku hua mutunga-ki-mutunga: te whakamaori i nga rerengamahi pakihi ki nga rohe punaha, tauira raraunga, API, me nga hononga, katahi ka kawe i nga mahi ma te whakamatautau, te tuku, me te whitiwhitinga. Ko te whainga he rorohiko ka taea e te roopu te whanake me te whakahaere, ehara i te kohinga o nga mata kua momotuhia.

entries.title: Hua me te Hangahanga Papa
entries.text: Ka whiriwhiri au i nga papaa me nga tauira i runga i te raru: nga ratonga .NET paparanga mo nga rohe pakihi, nga tono Angular, React ranei mo nga mahi uaua, hononga hononga. tauira raraunga mo nga rerenga mahi whai mana, me nga whakaurunga i hangaia me nga momo rahunga, te mana uru, me te pupuri i roto i te hinengaro.

entries.title: Whakaputa-Reri te Tukunga
entries.text: Ka hanga e au me nga mea pono i muri i te whakarewatanga i te tirohanga: nga mea ngaro i hunahia i waho i te mana o te puna, nga huarahi hekenga papaa raraunga marama, te whakamana i runga i nga mahi, te whakamana i nga rohe punaha, nga whakamatautau aunoa, te mohiotanga CI/CD, me te maataki mahi. Ko nga korero enei ka huri i tetahi tauira hei rorohiko pono.

biblioteca.title: Biblioteca JSON
biblioteca.text: He paipa-a-Pyton-a-roto e huri ana i tetahi puna ihirangi kua hangahia ki te kopaki e waatea ana ki te ao. Ka whakahaeretia e ia nga raraunga whakamaori hei punaha ka taea te pupuri, kaua i te kape wharangi-a-ringa, ka taea e te pae te huri ki te 100+ reo me te eke ki te ao katoa. te kaha whakahaere hei utu mo te waahanga kotahi.

connect_four.title: Hono Tuawha
connect_four.text: He whānau nui o ngā whakatinanatanga {implementations} o te kēmu Whā i te rārangi. Ka kapi te kaupapa i ngā reo papatono {languages}, tae atu ki te Java, C++, Python, me te JavaScript, me ngā anga, whare pukapuka, wā whakahaere, me ngā pātengi raraunga {frameworks} rerekē, mai i te React, Angular, me te Blazor ki te Django, Spring Boot, Phoenix, PostgreSQL, me ētahi atu.

grocery_app.title: Taupānga Toa
grocery_app.text: He tono .NET 9 Blazor Server tuke katoa e whakaatu ana i te hoahoanga o muri mo te rerengamahi pakihi. Ko te wehenga o te kaiwhakahaere/ratonga/reputaka e pupuri ana i nga ture tono, te urunga raraunga, me te whakaaturanga kia taea te whakamatautau takitahi; Ko te Anga Anga Hinonga Matua e whakarato ana i te u tonu; me te Ka tiakina e te huinga whakamatautau matawhānui te whanonga i te wa e tipu ana te hua.

interop.title: Kaupapa Interop
interop.text: He tohutoro mo te mahi-whakawhitinga reo e {languages} nga reo hootaka me te {patterns} tauira mahi. Ka tirotirohia e te kaupapa te rohenga i te nuinga o te wa ka pakarukaru nga punaha: nga kirimana tukatuka, te whakawhiti raraunga, te whanonga wa whakahaere, me nga huarahi whakauru tukurua. Ka whakaatahia nga whakaaro o nga punaha e hiahiatia ana ina he nui ake te hua i te puranga kotahi.

inventory_register.title: Rehita Rarangi
inventory_register.text: He POS me te rerenga mahi pukapuka-katoa i hangaia me te Angular 17+ me te Node.js. Ka whakatauira i nga awangawanga whakahaere o te punaha B2B: nga kaiwhakamahi kua whakamotuhēhēhia, te mana uru ki runga i te turanga, te tika o te raarangi, me te rerenga utu whakahi. I hoahoatia te kaupapa i runga i nga mahi tuturu e mahia ana e te roopu rehita, ehara i te raarangi o nga ahuatanga anga.

payrollobol.title: PayrollOBOL
payrollobol.text: He pūnaha tukatuka utu ā-rohe i hangaia me te GnuCOBOL, te pukapuka nui SQLite, me te papamahi whakahaere Svelte. Ka whakamahia e ia te pāngarau pene whētuituhi, te tukatuka utu puranga, me te papamahi loopback kia mārama, kia taea te whakamātautau, kia haepapa ai ngā rerenga moni.

formatter.title: Auto-Linter
formatter.text: He taputapu whakamana a JSON me te YAML i runga i te tirotiro i hangaia i roto i te Haere me te whakahiato ki te WebAssembly. Ko te neke i te miihini parsing ki roto i te WASM ka mau tonu te taunekeneke ki te aro me te rohe ki te kaitirotiro i te wa e tono ana he parser tuuturu hei hopu i te whakauru muhu. He tauira arotahi mo te kowhiri i te hoahoanga wa whakahaere mo te mahi, te kawe, me te whakawhirinaki a te kaiwhakamahi.

takeoff_engine.title: Mihini Takeoff
takeoff_engine.text: He hangahanga e whakatau tata ana i te SaaS i hanga huri noa i te rerenga mahi kaikirimana he utu nui, he hapa. Ko te hua React + Express ka whakauru i nga raraunga CSV me Excel, ka mapi i nga pou ritekore ki roto i te tauira rohe e taea ana te whakamahi, te tatau i te keri awaawa me te nui o te mahi whenua, te whai i nga mahi me tohu, me te whakaputa i nga tono PDF me te Kupu kua rite ki te kiritaki. Ko tenei te hangahanga huringa ora hua katoa: te poroporo raraunga, nga ture tatau, te rerengamahi orohia e te kaiwhakahaere, me nga taonga tuku hei awhina i te pakihi ki te neke mai i nga whakaurunga mata ki te tono.

minecraft_json_generator.title: Minecraft JSON Kaihanga
minecraft_json_generator.text: Kaihanga JSON mama i hangaia ki Python mo te rauemi Minecraft me nga kete raraunga. Ka whakamahia tenei kaupapa ki te whakaputa i nga konae JSON mo nga mods Minecraft, tae atu ki nga taonga ritenga, poraka, me nga hinonga. He tino pai mo te hanga i nga putea raraunga ritenga, engari mo nga mods ano hoki ma te waahanga whakarereke ingoa.

educational_experience.title: Taku Wheako Matauranga
educational_experience.text: I te taha o aku kaupapa ake, he maha ano nga pukenga kua riro mai i ahau mai i nga wheako matauranga. Paatohia a konei ki te tiro i taku korero LinkedIn mo etahi atu korero.

professional_experience.title: Taku Wheako Ngaio
professional_experience.text: E ono neke atu nga tau o te wheako miihini ngaio puta noa i nga roopu hua, papaa pakihi, me nga rorohiko e anga ana ki nga kaihoko. Ko aku mahi ko te hanga paparanga tono ka taea te pupuri, te mahi tahi puta noa i nga tikanga tuku, me te whakatau tikanga hangarau me te huringa ora o te hua, te whakahaere. morearea, me te mana pupuri mo te wa roa.

portfolio_website.title: Patrick Goodwin Portfolio Paetukutuku
portfolio_website.text: He kōpaki React e whakaaro nui ana ki te whakaputa e aro ana ki te urunga me te toronga o te ao hei whakaritenga miihini. Kei roto he paipa whakamaori ka taea te pupuri mo te 100+ reo, nga taputapu tauwhitiwhiti e tautokohia ana e WebAssembly, nga tauira UI aro me te uru, me te hoahoanga kaupapa. i hangaia kia tipu i te wa e tukuna ana nga mahi hou.

scripting_library.title: Whare pukapuka tuhinga
scripting_library.text: A consolidated library of automation scripts, with one page per language: VBA for Excel spreadsheets, Lua for lightweight tooling, PowerShell for Windows administration, Python for everyday data work, and Ruby for scripting experiments. Each script is written to be reused, so the collection is maintained as one project instead of five scattered repositories.

neovim_config.title: Patrick's Neovim Config
neovim_config.text: Taku whirihoranga Neovim whaiaro. Ka whakamahia tenei kaupapa ki te whirihora i a Neovim ki taku e pai ai, tae atu ki nga here matua, kaupapa, me nga mono. Ka whakamahia tenei kaupapa kia pai ake ai a Neovim ki te whakamahi me te pai mo taku whakamahi whaiaro.

python_maps.title: Patrick's Map Generator
python_maps.text: He taputapu purongo geospatial Python i hangaia me GeoPandas me Matplotlib hei whakaputa i nga mahere whenua me nga whenua o Amerika. Ka huri i nga raraunga matawhenua ki nga taonga tātari ka taea te panui, e whakaatu ana i te whakaaro paipa raraunga: kowhiria nga whare pukapuka rohe tika, whakatika i nga whakaurunga, ka whakaputa i nga putanga ka tautoko i nga whakatau marama.

pdf_builder.title: Kaihanga Pukenga PDF
pdf_builder.text: He rerengamahi whakaputa tuhinga i hangaia me te Python, Pdfkit, Jinja2, HTML, me nga raraunga JSON hanganga. Ka wehe i nga raraunga ka taea te whakamahi mai i nga tauira whakaaturanga hei whakaputa i nga tuhinga PDF kua rite tonu, he tauira mahi mo te whakaiti i nga mahi a-ringa me te hanga tuhinga pakihi. tukurua.

rijndael_encryption.title: Kaupapa whakamunanga Rijndael
rijndael_encryption.text: A comparative set of {implementations} Rijndael implementations across 128-, 192-, and 256-bit variants. Reimplementing a security-sensitive algorithm across languages is a disciplined exercise in exact specifications, testable behavior, and the limits of language-level portability, all useful instincts for systems that handle sensitive data.

suprememc.title: SupremeMC Minecraft Mod
suprememc.text: He mod Minecraft e tāpiri ana i ngā taputapu ritenga, pūweru, horoi, poraka, inenga, me ētahi atu āhuatanga maha ki te kēmu. I hangaia mātua ki te Java me te Kotlin, e tautoko ana i ngā putanga Minecraft 1.16 ki te 26.2.

rubix_cube_solver.title: Whakaahua Rubik's Cube
rubix_cube_solver.text: An interactive 3D Rubik's Cube you paint sticker by sticker - on the cube itself or on its unfolded net - and then solve with a Herbert Kociemba style two-phase search compiled from Rust to WebAssembly. The Svelte interface renders the cube with three.js, keeps the painted state, its validity checks, and the solver's facelet string in sync, and plays the solution back move by move on a timeline you can scrub, step through, and re-play.

snake.title: Kēmu nakahi
snake.text: He pūkaha Nakahi whakamiha i hangaia me te Rust me te Macroquad, i whakahiato ki WebAssembly, ā, i tuhia mā te HTML5 Canvas. Ka whakakotahi i ngā tiki kēmu 0.12-hēkona i te nekehanga i whakanekehia, ngā wāhanga kēmu mārama, te whakahaere urupare, te whakahaere tukinga me ngā āhua wikitoria, me tētahi huinga whakamātautau e kapi ana i ngā ture matua o te kēmu.

rustcraft.title: Rustcraft
rustcraft.text: A Minecraft-style voxel game built in Rust with wgpu and compiled to WebAssembly, so it plays straight in the browser. It is the arcade's sandbox build: blocky terrain and a voxel world drawn through a modern graphics pipeline, written from scratch on the Rust toolchain rather than on top of a game engine.

tiger_programming_language.title: Te Reo Papatono Tiger
tiger_programming_language.text: He reo whakahōtaka ritenga me te kaiwhakamaori i hangaia i roto Haere ki te tuhura i te hoahoa wa-haere reo, te whanonga mahi, me nga whakawhitinga mahi. Ko te whakahiato ki te WebAssembly me te whakauru ki roto i te kopaki ka hangaia he mata hua tino, ka taea te tirotiro mo te miihini taumata-raupapa, kaua ki te waiho i te mahi hei he whakamatautau-anake.

tiger_tailgating_pros.title: paetukutuku Tiger Tailgating Pros
tiger_tailgating_pros.text: He paetukutuku React i tukuna mo te pakihi tailgating Clemson, SC. Ka whakamaoritia e te mahi te tuku a te pakihi iti ki roto i te haerenga a nga kaihoko me te noho pono ki te paetukutuku, ma te whakamahi whakaaro hua hei awhina i tetahi whakahaere tuturu ki te huri i te hiahia. ki nga uiui me nga moni whiwhi.

turing_machine.title: Kaupapa Miihini Turing
turing_machine.text: He whanau {implementations} o nga whakatinatanga o te Miini Turing. Whakamahia ana ki te whakaatu turing completeness o nga reo whakahaere rereke mo te rangahau, tino mo te reo Tiger.

alkalab.title: Alkalab
alkalab.text: He whare pūtaiao matū onepū-puehu i hangaia i te Rust me te whakahiato ki WebAssembly. Peita i te onepū, te wai, te rangitoto, te maitai, te calcium carbide, tētahi wāhanga sodium rānei, ka mātakitaki ai i te whawhai a te ahupūngao me te matū: ka pahū te sodium i te wai, ka tukuna e te calcium carbide te acetylene, ka whakarewa te rangitoto i te onepū hei karaihe, ka wehewehe noa te irawe i te hinu, te mercury, me te onepū. Ka whakahaere te pūkaha i ngā rauemi 32 me ngā ture tauhohenga 40 ki runga i te pūhoro pūtau papatahi, e whāki ana i ngā pika mātātoa mai i te maharatanga rārangi wasm me te kore kape mō ia anga.

chess_engine.title: Miihini chess
chess_engine.text: A chess engine written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly. It searches with iterative deepening negamax, alpha-beta pruning, a 32 MB transposition table and a quiescence search at the leaves; it evaluates with tapered piece-square tables and orders moves by MVV-LVA, killers and history. The engine runs in a Web Worker so the board never freezes, and its move generator is checked in the browser against the published perft counts - 20, 400, 8,902, 197,281 and 4,865,609 nodes for the first five depths.

reclaim_4160.title: Reclaim 4160
reclaim_4160.text: Reclaim 4160 is a reclamation project: what began as a half-finished CPSC 4160 game in college - grab the last rolls of toilet paper and reach the checkout before the germs wear you down - has been rebuilt from scratch as a modern C++20 engine on SDL2 and compiled to WebAssembly. It ships ten escalating aisles with patrolling and chasing germ AI, pickups, particles and touch controls, none of the shortcuts of the original prototype.

pit_matching_engine.text: A deterministic, replayable limit-order-book matching engine. The engine itself is pure Ruby with no Rails in it, served by Rails 8 over a single SQLite file. Every command is appended to a write-ahead log before the engine sees it, so any past state of the book is one fold away, and a replay is proved faithful by comparing fingerprints recorded while the market was live. Price-time priority, GTC/IOC/FOK, amends that keep or lose queue position, and self-trade prevention are asserted by fourteen invariants after every command in a seeded fuzz suite. The browser gets a ten-hertz ladder over Action Cable, while commands go up over HTTP.
